fix.banCheckDisabled: The ban check is turned off in Settings; no recheck was made.
fix.cidBan.explanation: A CID ban cannot be removed locally; the ban is on the server side. Send the appeal text below so the admin can clear the right system.
fix.failure.adminDeclined: Administrator approval was not given or DHCP could not be renewed.
fix.failure.commandFailed: A network command failed. The interface was left up.
fix.failure.noDefaultRoute: No default network interface found; the fix was not started.
fix.failure.publicIPUnavailable: Could not get the public IP; the fix was not started.
fix.ipBan.step1: The current public IP is recorded.
fix.ipBan.step2: The default network interface is found (route get default).
fix.ipBan.step3: On Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi is turned off for 3 s and back on; on Ethernet, DHCP is renewed (macOS asks for administrator approval).
fix.ipBan.step4: The app waits up to 45 s for the network; the new public IP is fetched.
fix.ipBan.step5: If the IP changed, the ban is checked again for this server.
fix.locked: Another fix is running or one ran in the last 60 s; try again shortly.
fix.outOfRange: The new IP is banned too; since it is outside the range, this may be a CID/plugin ban.
fix.outcome.cancelled: The fix was cancelled. The interface was left up.
fix.outcome.changedCIDBanned: The IP changed (%@ → %@); there is no IP block, but the server has banned the CID.
fix.outcome.changedUnverified: The IP changed (%@ → %@); the ban status could not be verified.
fix.outcome.networkTimeout: The network did not come back within 45 s. The interface was left up; check your connection.
fix.outcome.resolved: Resolved: the IP changed (%@ → %@), the ban is lifted.
fix.outcome.stillBanned: The new IP may be banned too (subnet/range ban), or the server blocks the whole range.
fix.possibleCauses.title: Possible causes
fix.rangeBanned.suggestion1: Renewing the IP will not help; you are in the same range.
fix.rangeBanned.suggestion2: Try a different network: a mobile hotspot (tethering) or a VPN whose exit is in a different range.
fix.rangeBanned.suggestion3: Ask the server admin to remove the range ban (the appeal text includes the range).
fix.recheckThrottled: This server was checked in the last 10 s; try again shortly.
fix.risk: Risk: an IP change is not guaranteed; a static IP from your ISP, CGNAT or the router's PPPoE session may keep the IP. Other connections may drop during the outage. The administrator password is only requested in the macOS dialog; the app never sees or stores it.
fix.steps.title: Steps
fix.stillBanned.cause1: Range/subnet ban (IP bans are coarse and can even catch a CGNAT pool).
fix.suggestions.title: Suggestions
fix.unchanged.step1: Open the router admin page and reconnect the PPPoE/WAN connection there.
fix.unchanged.step3: The ban may be temporary: try again in a few hours.
